Per-branch PR templates"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"When creating a PR via issue-flow without an explicit body, the plugin fills a template by branch ty"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"pe: `feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, `chore/`, `refactor/`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### 3. Live Git Status Chip & Topological Commit Graph"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The client component injects a real-time Git Status Chip into the DSH Web UI chat header:
* **Active"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" Repository & Branch**: Displays current branch name (e.g., `feature/issue-42-auth`).
* **Tree Clean"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"liness**: Color-coded badges indicating clean vs dirty working trees and modified files count.
* **A"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"head/Behind Sync Badges**: Real-time sync indicator (`↑ahead`, `↓behind`) relative to upstream or `o"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"rigin/<branch>`.
* **Topological Commit Graph Modal**: Monospace branch/merge lane visualization (`●"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"`, `◆`, `│`), commit links to Gitea Web UI, branch and tag badges, and live Gitea Actions CI statuse"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"s (`CI ✓`, `CI ✗`, `CI ●`).
* **Cross-Tab Synchronization**: Efficient multi-tab coordination using "},{"id":"p21s8","text":"`navigator.locks` leader election and `BroadcastChannel`, eliminating duplicate network polling.
* *"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"*Uncommitted Diff Inspector**: 1-click panel showing recent commits and uncommitted diff."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### 3. Worktree Isolation & Agent Safety Rails"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"To allow autonomous agents to work on multiple issues without touching the primary branch:
* **Non-d"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"estructive Worktrees**: Creates worktree paths under `.worktrees/issue-<id>/` or custom directories."},{"id":"p23s3","text":"
* **Confirm Guard Matrix**: Destructive operations like `gitea_pr_merge` and `gitea_worktree_remove"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"` strictly require explicit boolean `confirm: true`. Unconfirmed tool calls are automatically reject"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ed.
* **Git Wrapper Enforcement**: Write operations can be routed through a dedicated wrapper (`gitW"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"rapper`, e.g., `git-deepseek-harness`) to enforce agent author signatures."}],"truncated":true}
